module_name: Modern NLP: Transformers, Embeddings, Semantic Search, Zero-shot
module_description: Module 12 builds the general NLP toolkit used by all later modules: pretrained transformers (BERT/RoBERTa/DeBERTa/XLM-R), Hugging Face fine-tuning and evaluation, sentence embeddings (SBERT/KataBERT/BGE multilingual), dense retrieval and vector stores, zero-shot classification, and practical constraints (CPU/Colab budgets, quantization, small-student-lab reality). Emphasis on evaluation rigor and calibration, not just accuracy.
core_concepts: Tokenization and model selection per language
learning_outcomes: C3 Fine-tune and evaluate a transformer classifier
C4 Build a semantic search interface over a social corpus
C5 Report calibration and per-class metrics, not accuracy alone
methods_models: Fine-tuning with Trainer/Accelerate, embedding generation, vector index (FAISS/Chroma/LanceDB), zero-shot NLI pipelines
evaluation_metrics: Accuracy, macro-F1, per-class PR, ECE calibration, retrieval MRR/recall@k, human agreement on sampled labels
pitfalls_limitations: Benchmark leakage, contamination from pretraining data, overfitting on small corpora, hubness in embedding similarity, misleading accuracy on imbalanced data
tools_stack: transformers, datasets, evaluate, accelerate, sentence-transformers (KataBERT for Indonesian), faiss, langchain/chroma (optional)
commercial_platforms: Commercial embedding/NLP APIs compared for accuracy and cost
tools_access_cost: Embedding APIs priced per million tokens; local models free but need GPU/CPU time
lab_activities: Fine-tune a classifier on a small corpus and evaluate; build a semantic search demo over the course dataset
datasets_apis: Any cleaned corpus from previous modules; Indonesian benchmark sets
assessment_methods: Lab notebook submission plus a 1-page interpretation with error analysis; graded on correctness, interpretation and documentation
data_collection_workflow: Collect posts -> clean text -> build annotation/codebook (human + LLM) -> validate with kappa -> train/evaluate -> archive labelled data and prompts
textbooks: Jurafsky & Martin, Speech and Language Processing, ch. 3-11
key_papers: 2024-2026 multilingual embedding models and retrieval papers
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: embedding-based semantic search and zero-shot LLM classification became standard components of analytics pipelines; local embedding models made this feasible on modest hardware
industry_relevance: Core competency for social-listening analyst, insights researcher and content-strategy roles; employers (Pulsar, Talkwalker, Meltwater, Brandwatch) list sentiment/topic extraction as the default screening task for junior analysts.
localization_context: Indonesia-specific models and lexicons (IndoBERT family, NusaBERT, InSet) plus local datasets (Indonesian sentiment/emotion/hoax sets) are used as the primary lab material, because English-oriented models underperform on code-mixed colloquial Indonesian.
ethics_regulation: Annotation labor and consent, model reporting of error rates, and disclosure that automated affective labels on individuals can misrepresent them; UU PDP applies when the corpus contains identifiable user text.
case_study_scenarios: Build a semantic search 'find similar complaints' tool over a customer-conversation corpus.
deliverable_format: Fine-tuning notebook + retrieval demo + metrics report
